claim: Per the Taiwan Stock Exchange, MOPS was set up on 1 August 2002 under the guidance of the FSC Securities and Futures Bureau by TWSE, TPEx and other bodies; it was revamped in 2010, and an optimized MOPS officially went into service on 21 October 2024.
evidence: "公開資訊觀測站係經行政院金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局指導，由臺灣證券交易所股份有限公司、財團法人中華民國證券櫃檯買賣中心等相關單位共同合作，於民國91年8月1日建立之網站" ... "歷經99年改版上線以來" ... "優化公開資訊觀測站於113年10月21日正式對外服務" (TWSE 觀點, 2024-11-28)
notes: ROC 91 = 2002, 99 = 2010, 113 = 2024. Replaces the TEJ-blog-based CLM-2191, whose 'current version launched July 2010' is outdated. TWSE gives only the year (2010) for the revamp, not July.

claim: TPEx moved Grand Process Technology (弘塑, 3131), a semiconductor equipment maker, from 'Other Electronic' to 'Semiconductor' from 1 June 2026; Gudeng (家登, 3680) was not among the 13 reclassified companies.
evidence: "櫃買中心今天公告，川寶、泰茂、全域、弘塑、斐成、台聯電訊、欣厚、光譜電工、廣運、華電聯網、中湛、友鋮、智通科創等13家上櫃公司，將調整產業類別，自今年6月1日起實施" ... "全域與弘塑由其他電子業分別調整為居家生活、半導體業" (CNA, 2026-05-19); MOPS Aug 2026 半導體業 table row "3131 弘塑 681,351"
notes: The Washin AI English rewrite (SRC-0767) mistranslated 弘塑 as 'Gudeng'. The point that the Semiconductor category missed some chip-supply-chain firms still holds, with Grand Process as the example. Chuan Bao (川寶, 1595) also moved, from Electronic Components to Semiconductor.

claim: Under CSRC's Measures for Information Disclosure of Listed Companies (Order No. 226, in force from 1 July 2025), the periodic reports a listed company must disclose are the annual report, due within four months of fiscal year-end, and the interim report, due within two months of the end of the first half-year.
evidence: "第十二条 上市公司应当披露的定期报告包括年度报告、中期报告。" "第十三条 年度报告应当在每个会计年度结束之日起四个月内，中期报告应当在每个会计年度的上半年结束之日起两个月内，编制完成并披露。" "第六十七条 本办法自2025年7月1日起施行。" (Order 226 text, MOJ database)
notes: The Measures no longer list a quarterly report (the 2007 Art. 20 one-month quarterly deadline in CLM-2205 is gone). Exchange listing rules may still require quarterly reports; those were not checked in this run.

claim: CSRC Order No. 226 (in force from 1 July 2025) requires disclosure documents in Chinese, with the Chinese text prevailing over any foreign-language version, and requires disclosed information to be published on the stock exchange's website and in media meeting CSRC conditions.
evidence: "第十条 信息披露文件应当采用中文文本。同时采用外文文本的，信息披露义务人应当保证两种文本的内容一致。两种文本发生歧义时，以中文文本为准。" "第八条 依法披露的信息，应当在证券交易所的网站和符合中国证监会规定条件的媒体发布" (Order 226 text)
notes: The 2007 rule (CLM-2206) that obligors may not publish on their own websites before the CSRC-appointed media does not appear in the 2025 text. 'Appointed media' is now 'media meeting CSRC conditions', alongside the exchange website.
